## Guess the flag

Look at the flag and choose its country or region. How many can you get right?

<div class="flag-game">
  <div class="game-score" aria-live="polite">
    Score: <span id="game-score">0</span> / <span id="game-round">0</span>
  </div>
  <img id="quiz-flag" class="quiz-flag" alt="Flag to identify">
  <div id="quiz-choices" class="quiz-choices"></div>
  <p id="quiz-feedback" role="status">Loading the flag quiz…</p>
  <button id="quiz-next" type="button" disabled>Next flag</button>
</div>

Choose a flag and a comparison method to see its three closest or most different matches. “Overall” combines color mix, pattern, and width-to-height ratio; the other options isolate one of those features.

<div class="flag-matcher">
  <div class="flag-controls">
    <label for="target-flag">Your flag
      <select id="target-flag"></select>
    </label>
    <label for="compare-by">Compare
      <select id="compare-by">
        <option value="overall">Overall</option>
        <option value="color">Color mix</option>
        <option value="pattern">Pattern / color placement</option>
        <option value="shape">Shape (width-to-height ratio)</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label for="match-order">Find

      </select>

<details>
  <summary>Browse all flags</summary>
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
flags <- sort(list.files(pattern = "^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]{3})?\\.png$"))
codes <- toupper(sub("\\.png$", "", flags))
items <- sprintf(
  '<figure><img src="%s" alt="Flag of %s" loading="lazy"><figcaption>%s</figcaption></figure>',
  flags, codes, codes
)
cat('<div id="flag-gallery" class="flag-grid">\n', paste(items, collapse = "\n"), '\n</div>\n', sep = "")
```
</details>

<script>
const flagImages = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#flag-gallery img"));
const flagSelect = document.querySelector("#target-flag");
const compareSelect = document.querySelector("#compare-by");
const orderSelect = document.querySelector("#match-order");
const statusMessage = document.querySelector("#match-status");
const results = document.querySelector("#match-results");
const regionNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(["en"], { type: "region" });
const quizImage = document.querySelector("#quiz-flag");
const quizChoices = document.querySelector("#quiz-choices");
const quizFeedback = document.querySelector("#quiz-feedback");
const quizNext = document.querySelector("#quiz-next");
const gameScore = document.querySelector("#game-score");
const gameRound = document.querySelector("#game-round");

const flags = flagImages.map((image) => {
  const code = image.alt.replace("Flag of ", "");
  let name = code;
  try {
    name = regionNames.of(code) || code;
  } catch {
    name = code;
  }
  const regionalNames = {
    "GB-ENG": "England",
    "GB-NIR": "Northern Ireland",
    "GB-SCT": "Scotland",
    "GB-WLS": "Wales"
  };
  name = regionalNames[code] || name;
  const option = document.createElement("option");
  option.value = code;
  option.textContent = `${name} (${code})`;
  flagSelect.append(option);
  return { code, name, src: image.src, ratio: image.naturalWidth / image.naturalHeight };
});

let quizDeck = [];
let currentQuizFlag;
let score = 0;
let round = 0;

function shuffled(items) {
  const copy = [...items];
  for (let i = copy.length - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [copy[i], copy[j]] = [copy[j], copy[i]];
  }
  return copy;
}

function nextQuizFlag() {
  if (quizDeck.length === 0) quizDeck = shuffled(flags);
  const previous = currentQuizFlag;
  if (quizDeck[0] === previous && quizDeck.length > 1) {
    [quizDeck[0], quizDeck[1]] = [quizDeck[1], quizDeck[0]];
  }
  currentQuizFlag = quizDeck.shift();
  round += 1;
  gameRound.textContent = round;
  quizImage.src = currentQuizFlag.src;
  quizImage.alt = "Flag to identify";
  quizFeedback.textContent = "Choose the country or region for this flag.";
  quizChoices.replaceChildren();
  quizNext.disabled = true;

  const choices = shuffled([
    currentQuizFlag,
    ...shuffled(flags.filter((flag) => flag !== currentQuizFlag)).slice(0, 3)
  ]);
  for (const flag of choices) {
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.textContent = flag.name;
    button.dataset.correct = String(flag === currentQuizFlag);
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const correct = flag === currentQuizFlag;
      if (correct) score += 1;
      gameScore.textContent = score;
      quizFeedback.textContent = correct
        ? `Correct! That's ${currentQuizFlag.name}.`
        : `Not quite — that's ${currentQuizFlag.name}.`;
      quizImage.alt = `Flag of ${currentQuizFlag.name}`;
      for (const choice of quizChoices.children) {
        choice.disabled = true;
        if (choice.dataset.correct === "true") choice.classList.add("correct");
      }
      if (!correct) button.classList.add("incorrect");
      quizNext.disabled = false;
      quizNext.focus();
    });
    quizChoices.append(button);
  }
}

quizNext.addEventListener("click", nextQuizFlag);
nextQuizFlag();

function extractFeatures(flag, context) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const image = new Image();
    image.onload = () => {
      flag.ratio = image.naturalWidth / image.naturalHeight;
      context.clearRect(0, 0, 16, 10);
      context.drawImage(image, 0, 0, 16, 10);
      const pixels = context.getImageData(0, 0, 16, 10).data;
      const grid = [];
      const histogram = Array(64).fill(0);
      for (let i = 0; i < pixels.length; i += 4) {
        const rgb = [pixels[i], pixels[i + 1], pixels[i + 2]];
        grid.push(...rgb);
        const bin = (rgb[0] >> 6) * 16 + (rgb[1] >> 6) * 4 + (rgb[2] >> 6);
        histogram[bin] += 1 / 160;
      }
      flag.grid = grid;
      flag.histogram = histogram;
      resolve();
    };
    image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${flag.code} flag image`));
    image.src = flag.src;
  });
}

function distance(first, second, method) {
  if (method === "color" || method === "overall") {
    let colorDifference = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < first.histogram.length; i += 1) {
      colorDifference += Math.abs(first.histogram[i] - second.histogram[i]);
    }
    colorDifference /= 2;
    if (method === "color") return colorDifference;

    let patternDifference = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < first.grid.length; i += 1) {
      patternDifference += Math.abs(first.grid[i] - second.grid[i]) / 255;
    }
    patternDifference /= first.grid.length;
    const shapeDifference = Math.min(
      Math.abs(Math.log(first.ratio / second.ratio)) / Math.log(2),
      1
    );
    return 0.4 * colorDifference + 0.45 * patternDifference + 0.15 * shapeDifference;
  }

  if (method === "pattern") {
    let difference = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < first.grid.length; i += 1) {
      difference += Math.abs(first.grid[i] - second.grid[i]) / 255;
    }
    return difference / first.grid.length;
  }

  return Math.min(Math.abs(Math.log(first.ratio / second.ratio)) / Math.log(2), 1);
}

function showMatches() {
  const selected = flags.find((flag) => flag.code === flagSelect.value);
  if (!selected?.grid) return;
  const ranked = flags
    .filter((flag) => flag !== selected)
    .map((flag) => ({ flag, score: distance(selected, flag, compareSelect.value) }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score || a.flag.code.localeCompare(b.flag.code));
  const matches = orderSelect.value === "closest"
    ? ranked.slice(0, 3)
    : ranked.slice(-3).reverse();

  results.replaceChildren();
  for (const { flag, score } of matches) {
    const figure = document.createElement("figure");
    const image = document.createElement("img");
    image.src = flag.src;
    image.alt = `Flag of ${flag.name}`;
    const caption = document.createElement("figcaption");
    caption.textContent = `${flag.name} (${flag.code}) — distance ${score.toFixed(2)}`;
    figure.append(image, caption);
    results.append(figure);
  }
}

flagSelect.addEventListener("change", showMatches);
compareSelect.addEventListener("change", showMatches);
orderSelect.addEventListener("change", showMatches);

async function prepareComparisons() {
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = 16;
  canvas.height = 10;
  const context = canvas.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true });
  let next = 0;
  async function loadNext() {
    while (next < flags.length) {
      const flag = flags[next];
      next += 1;
      await extractFeatures(flag, context);
    }
  }
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 4 }, loadNext));
  statusMessage.textContent = "Ready. Smaller distances mean closer matches.";
  showMatches();
}

prepareComparisons().catch((error) => {
  statusMessage.textContent = "Could not prepare flag comparisons. Try refreshing the page.";
  console.error(error);
});
</script>
